name: Banishing Smite
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The triggering hit deals an extra 5d10 Force damage. If it leaves the target with 50 Hit Points or fewer, the target makes a Charisma save; on a failure, it is transported to a harmless demiplane and is Incapacitated for the duration, then returns to its former space or the nearest open space.
